intro-2-1.text: Saltpan. Here the Loom spins our light into threads and sends them east. So we cut every thread.

after-1-2.text: Hush. Out on the salt, something's humming. It sounds like a loom.

after-4-1.text: Hear that? Both lights are falling the same way now.

ending-mina.text: Listen. The channel's gone quiet. Only the wind now.
